description:
Create a price.

Every model: one_time, pay_what_you_want (with a minimum), fixed_term (N days of access), subscription (interval, trial, grace, prepay), lifetime (optional cap and cohort tiers), credit_pack. Amounts are immutable; make a new price to change one.

Body is one of: model = one_time: needs product, model, unit_amount; model = pay_what_you_want: needs product, model, custom_amount; model = fixed_term: needs product, model, unit_amount, term_days; model = subscription: needs product, model, unit_amount, recurring; model = lifetime: needs product, model; model = credit_pack: needs product, model, unit_amount, credits.

Test keys only: refused with a live key.

currency.description: USD or EUR. Default: your account's currency.

minimum.description: The least a buyer may pay in minor units (cents), an integer.

suggested.description: Shown first in minor units (cents), an integer.

tiers.description: Cohorts in order: the first `seats` sell at the first price…

unit_amount.description: Price per seat in minor units (cents), an integer.

metadata.description: Your own key–value pairs (≤ 50 keys, values ≤ 500 characters). On an update they are merged in; an empty value removes its key.

grace_days.description: Days after the period ends before access stops. Default 3.

keep_renewal_price.description: A renewal keeps the price first paid. Default true.

prepay_max_periods.description: How many periods a buyer may pay ahead.

refunds.description: Refund terms the buyer accepts at checkout.

network_fee_payer.description: `buyer` (default): the network fee comes out of the refund. `merchant`: you pay it.

term_days.description: Days of access one purchase gives.

anyOf.description: Amount in minor units (cents), an integer.
Price per period in minor units (cents), an integer.
One price for every seat — or give `lifetime.tiers`.
